photo.title: textilier, indian, buss, marknad, korg, fotografi, photograph

Portrait of a woman weaving, viewed from the side. She wears a dark coloured skirt, light coloured top with pattern. Woman has braided hair and earrings. Around her waist is a harness supporting a weaving device made of sticks and covered in white and black string. She hangs on to a wooden stick on the device with both hands and leans back. Sand, rocks and plants in background.
